module: Checks whether the user has answered the online consent wizard (settings `onlineFeatures` and `telemetry`, value "ask" = not answered yet). Used by the UI router to prevent leaving the consent screen until it is validated.
notes: In simple menu (Engine.UI.isSimpleMenu()), if consent is not given, the module automatically enables onlineFeatures and telemetry ("enable"), requests saving the settings and considers consent as given (the terms are assumed accepted).

isOnlineConsentSet.desc: Returns true if telemetry and onlineFeatures are both different from "ask". Side effect in simple menu: enables both settings and saves.

canLeaveOnlineConsent.desc: Returns whether navigating away from the current route is allowed: always true inside the `legal.*` route tree (to finish the wizard), otherwise depends on isOnlineConsentSet().

route.desc: UI route (name field of the form "legal.xxx").
